4/S0.subgoal: Introduce the lecture and explain its goal of defining VR and AR terms.

4/S2.subgoal: State the dictionary definition of virtual reality.

4/S3.subgoal: Explain the first characteristic of a VR system: having an artificial environment.

4/S4.subgoal: Describe how VR systems must provide sensory stimuli for immersive experience.

4/S5.subgoal: Explain the third characteristic of a VR system: interactivity.

4/S6.subgoal: Apply the three characteristics to determine if various systems qualify as VR.

4/S7.subgoal: Summarize the definitions and three characteristics of Virtual Reality.
